name: Sys.yearqtr
title: An Index Class for Quarterly Data

origin.details: Sys.yearqtr returns as.yearqtr(Sys.Date()), the local calendar quarter. The recorded value is yearqtr(2000 + (1 - 1) / 4), quarter 1 of 2000, so the check does not depend on the clock.
origin.example:
x <- yearqtr(2000 + (1 - 1) / 4)
cat(paste("yearqtr", sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x)), format(x), sep = " "), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: The current local year and quarter.
translation.details: sys_yearqtr converts today's local date through as_yearmon and then yearqtr. The recorded value is yearqtr(2000 + (1 - 1) / 4), which is 2000 Q1.
translation.example:
from zoo.yearqtr import format_yearqtr, yearqtr
x = yearqtr(2000 + (1 - 1) / 4)
print("yearqtr", format(float(x.value[0]), ".17g"), format_yearqtr(x)[0])
